coefficient_format: gzip of 2*n little-endian binary64 words, first real-residual test then imaginary-residual test; P1 vertices first, then all sorted mesh edges

backend.solver: cg with diagonal preconditioner on K_P2 + 11^T/n; proposal RHS subtracts floating Euclidean mean
backend.scope: Numerical Riesz test proposals only; exact lower certificate needs neither a solver tolerance guarantee nor exact Galerkin optimality.
